findings.claim: Duplicate deliveries of the same Stripe event arriving concurrently are not idempotent: the find-then-create in record_from_stripe_event! races, the unique index fires, and the second request returns 500, which makes Stripe retry a third time.

evidence.reproduction: ruby /mnt/session/outputs/probes/concurrent_webhook.rb (20 parallel POSTs, same evt_ id)
evidence.observed: 2/20 runs: ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique raised from line 36; response 500
evidence.expected: AC-3: exactly one row and 200 on every delivery

findings.refutation_condition: Show the probe passing 20/20 with the same input, or show that the controller layer already serialises per-event processing (I found no lock or job queue at app/controllers/webhooks/stripe_controller.rb:14-40).
findings.suggested_fix: Use insert with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (Rails insert_all with unique_by: :stripe_event_id) or rescue RecordNotUnique and return the existing row.

findings.claim: final_attempt is set from invoice.next_payment_attempt.nil?, but Stripe also sends next_payment_attempt null when the invoice is paid or voided; on a payment_failed event for a voided invoice this marks a false final attempt and publishes RetriesExhausted.

evidence.reproduction: payment_failed fixture with status 'void' and next_payment_attempt null -> RetriesExhausted published
evidence.expected: AC-4 intends 'Stripe gave up', which is status 'open' with next_payment_attempt null

findings.refutation_condition: Show that Stripe never emits invoice.payment_failed for a voided invoice (cite Stripe docs or a webhook log), or that status is already checked somewhere upstream.
findings.suggested_fix: Set final_attempt only when invoice.status == 'open' && next_payment_attempt.nil?.

findings.claim: The AC-7 test asserts FailureNotifier was called but not that it was called exactly once; a double call would pass.

findings.claim: failure_code is stored as the raw Stripe decline code string with no length limit; a limit of 64 matches Stripe's documented codes.
findings.refutation_condition: Project convention stores Stripe strings unbounded elsewhere.
